title: What a Mighty God You Are

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: All knees shall bow in reverence to You

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord of hosts who rules with grace and truth
All whose mind are centered in You

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Your name is exceedingly far above all others
All things bright and beautiful You made
The universe You created by your infinite wisdom

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, what a mighty God You are
What glorious privilege it is to bless Your holy name

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: I stand in awe of Your magnificent power
With every second of my days

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Oh, what a mighty God You are
What glorious privilege it is to bless Your holy name
